messages:
ana.m: Quick sync: AWS Secrets Manager + our marketplace connector onboarding checklist. Partners requested SCIM group sync, SAML metadata exchange, and optional HSM-backed keywrap.
ravi.s: We're targeting GA in 3 weeks for marketplace listing. Need to confirm Secrets Manager's exportable key policy vs our KMS integration pattern. Anyone seen issues with external key wrapping?
kate.g: FYI partner's SI says they prefer using customer-managed keys (CMK) in their account. That means we should support external KMS integration where we only receive wrapped DEK.
infra-bot: preflight: 1) SAML metadata schema valid (ok) 2) SCIM endpoint responds (ok) 3) KMS wrap/unwrap smoke (partial)
nana.m: (typo) ana.m: re infra-bot - partial KMS smoke: unwrap fails with EKM error from partner's HSM. Ravi can you pull HSM logs?
ravi.s: grabbing logs now. Looks like the partner HSM uses RSA-KEM with OAEP label = "redwood-ekm" which we don't include in our unwrap call.
kate.g: We can add optional label support, but need product sign-off. Also ask legal: does adding label break customer audit trails?
security: Adding label should be fine but we need to record label usage in audit logs. Also require partner to provide proof of FIPS mode and attestation for the HSM.
partners-team: For marketplace listing, we need a short blurb on SSO integration and a step-by-step for SCIM provisioning. Draft attached: https://redwood.internal/partners/aws-secrets-marketplace-blurb-draft
ana.m: (typo) ana.m: SCIM mapping note: partner only sends 'members' array with references, no 'roles'. We'll need a mapping UI or default mapping.
ravi.s: Suggest default mapping to 'editor' for group owners and 'viewer' for others, with ability to override via connector settings.
kate.g: Can we also support on-the-fly role mapping transforms? E.g., regex map 'eng-*' -> 'engineer'. That would reduce ops friction.
infra-bot: deploy-checklist update: add 'EKM label test' and 'audit log label presence'.
security: Also require retention policy for SCIM logs (90 days internal by default) and mark any PII in logs for redaction.
partners-team: Announcement plan: partners want a co-branded marketplace tile and joint press release. We need a security Q&A for marketing to vet claims about 'HSM-backed' and 'customer-managed keys'.
nana.m: (typo) ana.m: I'll draft the security Q&A. Start with: "What does HSM-backed mean?" and "How does Redwood handle customer-managed keys?"
ravi.s: Engineering action: add optional KMS label parameter and a connector flag 'allow_external_cmk=true'. I'll open a PR today.
kate.g: Legal, any pre-approved wording for 'HSM-backed' on marketplace?
security: Don't use 'HSM-backed' alone; prefer 'supported HSM attestation and customer-managed-key workflows' with link to compliance doc.
partners-team: Timeline recap: PR this week, staging tests next Tue, runbook final by next Fri, marketing draft for co-brand by following Mon.
nana.m: (typo) ana.m: I'll schedule a 30m call with partner SREs for Wed 9am PT to walk through KMS label test.
infra-bot: reminder: include sample SCIM delta and SAML metadata example in runbook.
ravi.s: Uploading sample unwrap trace to the partnership ticket now.
kate.g: Thanks all. If staging KMS test passes, we can sign the marketplace listing NDA and proceed with co-brand assets.
partners-team: Noted.
security: Please ensure partners grant permission for us to log group names and minimal identifiers for troubleshooting (consent clause).
nana.m: (typo) ana.m: Closing: I'll collect all artifacts and circulate a final checklist before the Wed call.
